_purpose: Pre-registered ACTIONS keyed to a catalyst, so a graded call FIRES its action instead of just updating a Brier. Kept OUT of the append-only calibration ledger: the PROBABILITY is frozen at prediction; the PLAN can be registered/updated here. Keyed by ticker, optional per event_type. anchor='pre_catalyst_close' => entries anchor to the close BEFORE the print; a LATE action must NOT chase the pop (stand down if price already ran past the anchor).

BKE.auto_confirm_note: MECHANICAL grade — a monthly comp is positive/negative vs a frozen gate; near-zero mis-grade risk. Auto-resolves only at conf>=0.85 with no model disagreement; else stays manual-confirm.

favorable.plan: Starter add on the confirmed positive comp. GTC value ladder AT/BELOW the pre-catalyst close and near the 52wk low; DO NOT pay up for the print pop. If price already ran >1% above the anchor, STAND DOWN and wait for the post-Q2 confirmation add. Size: low end of DD-survived (~2.5% of the IBKR sleeve); this is not a calibration size-up (n<20).

unfavorable.plan: A negative comp starts the 2-month exit clock on the held position (per the frozen thesis). Re-underwrite before adding; do not average down into a demand break.
